brandSources.note: Copied from the site's own CSS tokens: --background #ffffff, --card #f7f7f7, --foreground #0a0a0a. Ground's identity is essentially monochrome — black ink on white — and the theme keeps it that way.
The site's --muted-foreground is #737373; darkened to #595959 so secondary text clears 4.5:1 on the white canvas with margin. Recorded as a deliberate adjustment, not a brand value.

Judgement call for a monochrome brand, per playbook: the signature colour was taken from the product's own data colours — the deep blue of its bias bar / chart palette (probe accent candidate, x9 uses), the left-hand colour of the Left–Center–Right bar that is the product's signature visual. Contrast on white is about 9:1.

Built from the site's own palette family, not a rainbow: promise in the bias-bar blue #204986, method in the site's chart blue #2563ef (--chart-3), contradictions in the bias-bar deep red #802727 (probe accent candidate), money in a darkened form of the site's tan/gold #d1bd91 (its centre-bar colour, darkened to clear 3:1 on white), company in the site's own neutral grey #525252, and the audit — Claim Checker's cluster, not Ground's — in a deep cyan neighbour of the chart blues. Each clears 3:1 on #ffffff.

The site uses proprietary faces (universalSans / sohneSans, Söhne-style grotesques) that are not on Google Fonts. Approximated with the system-ui grotesque stack the site itself ships as a fallback family; no webfont. The page reads identically with no network font.
Ground News's logo is deliberately not embedded. This is an unaffiliated independent study by Claim Checker / TeamBotics, and the disclaimer in story.json says so. The wordmark is plain text.

font.body: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif
